thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated KV cache growth and tail latency on /v1/generate for model xg-7b-v2. Alert: KV_CACHE_GROWTH_HIGH. Paging @mike (oncall).

mike (oncall): I'm awake, looking. Pulling recent traces and node metrics.

alice (serving): logs show continuous-batching queues accumulating drafts. Per-shard kvcache_size jumped from 4GB -> 18GB in ~7m.

drew (ml): We pushed speculative-decoding default for xg-7b-v2 in the last deploy. Hypothesis: speculative drafts are creating draft/target divergence that prevents effective KV eviction under current batching.

carol (infra): I can see batch_max_tokens got increased to 8192 in the deploy at 1935006000. That + speculative decode might be amplifying state in KV.

mike (oncall): Can we reduce batch_max_tokens and flip speculative decoding off as quick mitigation? What's the admin path?

alice (serving): Admin endpoints:
```
POST /admin/config
{ "batch_max_tokens": 2048 }
POST /admin/feature_flags
{ "speculative_decoding": false }
```
I'll run both. Expect rolling config apply across serving fleet ~60-90s per region.

carol (infra): Applying batch_max_tokens=2048 to canary pool now.

incident-bot: Deploybot: config change triggered. Rolling update to 12 pods in canary.

ben (support): Customer Acme reported 502/timeout spikes starting ~1935006100. Notified CSEs and support channel.

drew (ml): If we disable speculative decoding, drafts shouldn't be produced at same rate. But existing draft entries may linger — we might need to evict hot shards.

alice (serving): Evicting hot kvcache shards matching pattern hot-*: 
```
POST /admin/kvcache/evict?pattern=hot-*
```
Starting now.

carol (infra): Canary pods back with batch_max_tokens=2048, latency dropping on canary traces.

incident-bot: Alert state: KV_CACHE_GROWTH_HIGH -> mitigating (config rollback in progress)

mike (oncall): Rolling change to prod. Turning speculative_decoding=false cluster-wide.

alice (serving): Speculative flag toggled. Monitoring for error rate and KV size.

ben (support): Acme confirms a drop in 502s, can still see a few streaming stalls but much improved. CSEs sending update.

drew (ml): Note for postmortem: speculative decoding + larger batch_max_tokens created pathological draft growth where draft and target keys diverged and prevented LRU eviction because draft writes kept resurrecting keys.

carol (infra): Post-hook: increased eviction pressure observed during evict call. kvcache size falling back to baseline.

mike (oncall): All signals trending back to normal. SLA error rates down to baseline. I'll hand off to carol to monitor overnight and to Drew/Alice to run repro and eval.

mike (oncall): Handoff: @carol you'll own watch for next 8h, @drew @alice please prepare an eval and a repro run for the postmortem. I'll draft an incident summary.

carol (infra): Ack. Running extended mem/evict monitor. If kvcache re-rises, we'll throttle speculative-decoding per-model instead of global disable.

drew (ml): Also adding a guard: when batch_max_tokens > 4096, speculative_decoding should be disabled by default — will open PR and an alert to prevent future combos.

ben (support): Sending customer impact notice: short blip, partial streaming errors for ~7 minutes between 1935006100-1935006430. No data loss, most requests retried ok.

mike (oncall): Closing active paging. Will post a short incident note and schedule follow-up with PM/reliability to track longer-term mitigations (rate-limit policies, per-model flags, async eviction improvements).

incident-bot: Incident: RESOLVED — KV cache growth mitigated and services returned to normal. Update: follow-up tasks assigned.

alice (serving): Thanks team. We'll keep an eye on the rollout of the guard PR.

carol (infra): I'll leave a monitoring dashboard pinned and update the runbook with the evict endpoint steps.

mike (oncall): Good work. Handing to oncall rotation: @carol still owning. I'll update the incident channel with the summary in 30m.
